results.name: Os Perseguidos
results.description:
After the scan made with Display.land by Artur Coelho which can be found here https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/os-perseguidos-aef94ed6cda248d2a82947c9e025acd6

The original sculpture is "Os perseguidos" by Pedro Anjos Teixeira.

I repaired the scan, used a handful of web photos to recover some details that were not in the scan, then did an automatic retopo (hence the high polygon count) 
The textures are a mix of the original scan's textures and my own smart materials.
All the post-processing of the scan was done in 3d-Coat.

I did not "de-light" it, because much of the detail was on the scan's original textures. Removing the lighting would effectively remove the detail.

results.name: Rigged T-Pose Human Male w 50 Face Blendshapes
results.description:
This is a rigged scan of me free to download and use in whatever weird thing you want to put it in.

Scanned by Doob, optimized and rigged by High Fidelity. I've retargeted animations, used it as a game character in Unity, an avatar in VR, and rendered videos with it.

The only texture is a color diffuse. It would probably look better with roughness, normals, etc. for skin, hair, and clothing. But this is okay for wide and medium distances.

results.name: Handsome man in casual clothes in A-pose 86
results.description:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 

This is a true human size detailed model of a  hadsome man dressed in casual style. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software. 

**Technical characteristics:**

* digital double scan model
* low-poly model
* fully quad topology
* sufficiently clean
* edge Loops based
* ready for subdivision
* non-overlapping UV map
* ready for animation
* 16K texture color map
* PBR textures 8K/4K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Roughness maps
* 16K Albedo map resolution
Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.

**3D EVERYTHING**
